sign: Ochrewell, 140 folk. 141 if you stay. Most do, one way or another.
West: the wind towers. East: the oasis. South: the sun palace. North: the way out, rarely used.

lines: Well Keeper Sefa: The well is free. The bucket costs extra. The rope is a matter for the Brass Veil.
Well Keeper Sefa: Drink. Your Spirlings look like raisins.
Bazaar Trader Oskin: Everything here is genuine. Especially the fakes.
trader.action: shop strong_tonic max_tonic remedy cooling_gel wake_bell revival_leaf dash_brew guard_brew

lines: Factor Lusk: Ah, the one who ruined a perfectly good investment. Kaia sends her regards. Well, she sent an invoice.
Factor Lusk: The Brass Veil does not hold grudges. We hold contracts. Yours just expired.

factor_after: Factor Lusk: Consider this a receipt. The Veil keeps copies of everything. Especially of people.
factor_defeat: Factor Lusk: Hm. Expensive. I'll put you down as a loss. Not mine, naturally.
Factor Lusk: Kaia was our best buyer in years. Sold her own oasis for the price of a nicer grave.
Factor Lusk: Ask Emrys at the palace who signed as witness. Then ask why he never mentioned it.
factor_lose: Factor Lusk: Come back when you can afford to lose properly.

lines: Potter Hadi: I make domes by day and urns by night. Business is steady in both.
Spice Seller Ranya: At dusk we all meet at the well and pretend we don't owe the Veil money.
Gravedigger Tobs: Sand's easy to dig. Harder to keep shut. The wind tells on everybody.
